subject: maths
question:
Refer the following data table and answer the question.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bf51b4415c7f8fe1ed4435691156a36be5f34fcaec426756fb68d3c986c3f86.png] 

What was the increase in the height (in cm) of the child from the 7th birthday to the 8th birthday?
solution:
**Given:**

Height on 8th birthday = 170 cm

Height on 7th birthday = 162 cm

**Formula used:**

Increase in height = Height on 8th birthday - Height on 7th birthday

**Calculation:**

Increase in height = 170 - 162

⇒ Increase in height = 8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
